note: Shared comparison cases for the two engines that must agree on what counts as the same soldier name: the game client (IronPath/character-name.mjs, policy NFC_LOWERCASE_V1) and the offline audit script (IronPath/scripts/audit-character-names.py, Unicode default case folding). `same` is what the game ENFORCES; `casefoldSame` is what the audit REPORTS. Where the two differ the audit is deliberately stricter - see CHARACTER-NAME-AUDIT.md. Changing either engine without changing this file means the two drifted apart.

cases.why: outer ECMAScript whitespace is not a difference
composed and decomposed accents normalize to the same form
non-Latin case is still not a difference
KNOWN DIVERGENCE: Unicode default case folding expands the sharp s, plain lowercasing does not. The audit reports it as a conflict, the game does not block it.
compatibility characters are not conflated by either engine; a stricter character rule would be a separate decision
trailing space in a stored legacy name is not a new name
